sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00) in what should be a straightforward assignment against a struggling side currently bottom of the table with just 4 points. After a recent loss, Sandbach will be keen to return to winning ways and maintain their 1-point advantage at the summit; they then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00) in another opportunity to consolidate their position.
divisionWide: Title contenders Stafford Town (second, 20 points) face Dawley Town away on Saturday 3 October before hosting Wednesfield Community on Saturday 10 October. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall on Saturday 3 October, while fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community on the same day. In-form Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) visit Foley Meir on Saturday 3 October before hosting Crewe on Saturday 10 October. Struggling Shawbury United (15th, on a six-game losing run) host Barnton on Saturday 3 October then travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 10 October. Other Saturday 3 October fixtures include: Brereton Social v Widnes Town, Cheadle Heath Nomads v Telford Town, Crewe v Allscott Heath, and Market Drayton Town v New Mills. A midweek clash sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October (KO 19:45). Saturday 10 October's remaining matches feature Allscott Heath hosting Brereton Social, Barnton welcoming Dawley Town, and Telford Town visiting New Mills.
